scope: repository-root deployment documentation and prerequisite probes only
project_files_policy: all files under projects/ must retain their base SHA-256
frozen_assets_policy: preserved unchanged including user-approved golden workbook copies

newline_reproduction.acceptance: fresh checkout has zero manifest hash mismatches and passes original project validators

inventory_policy: explicit private bindings/config and OS metadata are not release inputs and cannot be declared in the inventory; unreviewed business files still fail
